The upside capture ratio shows how the fund performs in comparison to its benchmark when the market goes up.

If the performance of two funds is approximately similar, then the lower expense ratio fund gets a natural advantage, especially in long-term investing where this difference can be increased due to compounding.

both have their own characteristics.
